evals.title: Collective credit and calibrated causality
evidence: Fresh execution of scripts/run-knowledge-development.mjs recomputed fingerprint 5ce44ac5e3288537f2a23e83a49a9e6ef5558d6508080b2569653d4d1dbc2b25; KD-013 independently scored 4 with zero findings.

Row-level recomputation of kctownhall-full-population.json produced 183 unique primary URLs, 170 Posts records, 183 Replies primary records, five disjoint other-account context cards, and 188 rendered Replies cards. Types recomputed to 142 originals, 13 replies, and 28 reposts; all 155 account-authored records are originals or replies, while all 28 reposts retain their source authors.

CLM-KCTH-SOCIAL-OPERATING-SURFACE explicitly keeps the feed institutional, rejects personal authorship, excludes tags and mentions as engagement, distinguishes responses from endorsement or causality, treats 267 visible interaction units as volatile context rather than reach or impact, and holds self-published tire and savings totals for independent corroboration.

SRC-KCTH-LUCAS-LEONS-RESPONSE-2019-04-29, SRC-KCTH-JUSTUS-LEONS-RESPONSE-2019-04-29, and SRC-KCTH-ROBINSON-COMMUNITY-CONDITIONS-2020-08-01 preserve each official's authorship. Official KCMO records separately document their Council service on the relevant dates. SRC-KCTH-BTG-TIRE-DROPOFF-2019-07-08 retains collaborator credit, while the fixture separately records KCMO311 and two bounded community amplifications.

Curated reporting sources in social-media-production.ts are labeled as material circulated by the account, not coverage of KC Town Hall. The claim also explicitly separates social evidence from the municipal funding agreement, receipt, expenditure, completion, transition, and causal-government questions.

The wider bank preserves the same calibration: CLM-NYCAC-CABARET-REPEAL-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE credits the multi-group campaign and institutional actors; CLM-NYCAC-MARCH-TRANSPARENCY-LAW rejects individual causality; CLM-CRS-COALITION-OPERATING-SYSTEM distinguishes Jamie's designed system from collaborative memory; and the CallNYC, NYCAC, and WOW List social claims retain institutional-account authorship boundaries.
Fresh focused tests passed 39/39. npm run check:citations, npm run public-safety, and npm run knowledge-bank all exited 0.
evals.recommended_next_move: Accept at score 4; retain the existing authorship, outcome-corroboration, and funding-separation guardrails in future edits.

evals.title: Source-backed strength through Chad's lens
evidence: kc-town-hall.mdx gives a skeptical hiring reader a compact sequence: long-vacant-building situation, Jamie's City-documented developer/presenter role, planning and documentation method, public operating surface, usable municipal decision record, neighborhood/public-benefit purpose, transition stewardship, and explicit limits.

The selected CLM-KCTH-SOCIAL-OPERATING-SURFACE projection is specific and purposeful without metric theater: it describes resident input, recurring tire-pickup intake, civic-resource circulation, three direct Council responses, and Bridging the Gap corroboration while expressly rejecting personal-feed authorship, participation totals, endorsement, completion, and causal impact.

Independent fixture recomputation yielded 118 records with external links, 133 occurrences, and 31 distinct short URLs. Public-safe row labels yielded exactly 100 tire-related records and 12 survey-linked records; the 12 survey labels matched the 12 rows mechanically derived from destinations containing “survey,” with no mismatches.

Interaction recomputation over the 155 account-authored rows yielded 77 records with activity, 22 replies, 70 reposts, 174 likes, one bookmark, and 267 units. The fixture and claim both identify these as volatile interface observations, not adoption, reach, participation, endorsement, or impact.

The immutable fixture source URL is pinned to commit 303fcd47f6760d15822d793f1a744cfe17055ad8. The working fixture and that commit's blob both resolved to Git blob 6f7546f52aa2dc36870a48e238aa613be704a97b, establishing byte identity.

records.ts and public-registry.json order KC Town Hall sources by first visible claim appearance. Fresh citation tests resolved developer/presenter to source 1, the social claim to sources 2–10, and the funding chain to sources 11–13.

RT-SOCIAL-KCTH-TIRE-OUTCOME-CORROBORATION remains high-priority and open; RT-SOCIAL-KCTH-SURVEY-AND-SITE-RECOVERY remains open with explicit recovery and privacy criteria. These preserve unresolved outcome, survey-response, and decision-trail value without premature promotion.

The fixture contains no raw-post-text, cookie, session, authentication, phone-number, direct-message, or private-message fields; recursive key and phone-pattern checks found zero matches. The public registry reproduces no phone number and notes that the linked historical post's contact details and raw text were excluded.

The wider selected bank remains hiring-legible and source-backed: direct actions such as coalition operating-system design, privacy-preserving data requirements, Council testimony, CallNYC development, and archive tooling are stated specifically, while collective outcomes and unresolved claims remain bounded or tasked. Fresh citation, public-safety, knowledge-bank, and 39 focused tests all passed.
evals.recommended_next_move: Accept at score 4; preserve the fixture pin, row-level classification methods, open research tasks, and explicit separation between institutional context and Jamie's sourced role.
